title: Map Asset Production & Artwork — placeable object library
owner_approval: 2026-11-25: owner explicitly approved revised 192-sheet individually placeable object catalog and directed first six individual generated sheets.
scope: Artwork only, supports MMHT; no product code, gameplay simulation or selector changes.

supersedes.reason: Owner rejected non-seamless texture swatches and planning graphic. Prior list retired, not a production queue. No new artwork credited from rejected attempt.

reference: UHT24 MME02H existing 48 detailed illustrated sprites; owner-approved revised catalog in conversation.
batch_order: First batch cross-genre pilot; subsequent batches select next six outstanding entries by stable ID unless owner directs otherwise.

format.default: One individual sheet image, exactly 12 separate objects in 4 columns by 3 rows. Larger structures may need fewer objects when specified.
format.quality: Detailed semi-realistic digitally painted sprites; overhead or restrained elevated overhead; intricate textures, visible material and craftsmanship, neutral directional lighting, transparent or clean removable background, generous spacing, complete isolated silhouettes, no external baked shadows.
exclude: Text labels, sheet headers, borders and grids

status_definitions.generated: Correct-type individual image produced, not owner approved or import tested
status_definitions.revision_needed: Output failed brief or needs correction
status_definitions.integrated: Map Maker placement and import verified

batch_policy: All six descriptions before any image generation. Six separately generated artwork outputs, never a collage of sheets. Verify each output visually, attach evidence, do not count off-brief outputs; keep generated distinct from approved, processed and integrated. Named world canon review before briefs.

sheets.title: Deciduous trees: oak, maple, birch, willow and others

brief.name: Deciduous trees
brief.description: Twelve distinct directly overhead tree canopies, finely rendered branching and dense individual leaf clusters; varied natural colors and irregular silhouettes. No terrain disks.

artwork_evidence.review: 12 overhead tree canopies in separate sheet; alpha exists; margin, edge contamination, botanical identity, individual extraction and placement not yet validated; owner review pending.

sheets.title: Coniferous trees: pine, spruce, cedar and fir

brief.name: Coniferous trees
brief.description: Twelve individually placeable conifer crowns seen directly overhead, with realistic fine needle clusters, layered branch whorls, contrasting species silhouettes and green to blue-green variation. No trunks viewed from the side or ground disks.

sheets.title: Bushes, shrubs and hedges

brief.name: Bushes, shrubs and hedges
brief.description: Overhead shrub silhouettes showing branching, layered leaves and varied growth habits, from compact round shrubs to clipped and loose hedges. Individual isolated foliage objects, not repeating textures. Hedge ends are visible and complete.

sheets.title: Wildflowers and flowering plants

brief.name: Wildflowers and flowering plants
brief.description: Overhead botanical flowering clusters with individually painted blossoms and leaves; natural irregular footprints, high contrast at tactical zoom, distinct species palettes. No underlying soil or meadow rectangles.
cells_row_major: Mixed wildflower bouquet growing in place

sheets.title: Ferns, grasses and groundcover clusters

brief.name: Ferns, grasses and groundcover clusters
brief.description: Overhead individual plants and small clumps, fine leaf detail and naturally irregular margins; differentiated growth patterns and scale. Isolated greenery only, no tile backgrounds.

sheets.title: Fallen trees, dead trees, stumps and exposed roots

brief.name: Fallen trees, dead trees, stumps and exposed roots
brief.description: Overhead woodland debris and deadwood with weathered bark, split wood fibers, growth rings, moss and distinctive broken silhouettes. Large trunks completely visible in their cells, no ambient scene or extraneous ground.

sheets.title: Tropical jungle trees

brief.name: Tropical jungle trees
brief.description: True overhead tropical tree canopies, rich layered foliage with identifiable palm fronds, broad leaves and irregular jungle crowns; distinct plant forms, natural emerald and olive palette, no ground or scene.
